data.name: Laser Planet
data.detailed_description:
LASER PLANET - Professional Laser Shooting Range System

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This software requires the Laser Planet hardware system (specialized camera and laser weapon replica). The hardware is sold separately by the manufacturer.

Laser Planet is professional shooting range software designed to work exclusively with the Laser Planet hardware system. Our complete solution combines a specialized detection camera with precision laser weapon replicas for authentic shooting simulation and training.

HOW IT WORKS:

The Laser Planet system uses a custom camera with advanced optics optimized for red laser detection, paired with professional weapon replicas that fire precisely calibrated red laser beams. The software tracks each shot with pixel-perfect accuracy while any standard projector displays interactive shooting scenarios on any surface. Automatic calibration takes just seconds - point your projector at a wall and start training.

KEY FEATURES:

🔫 Professional Laser Planet Hardware Required

Works exclusively with Laser Planet camera and weapon replicas. Our hardware is specifically designed for reliable laser detection in various lighting conditions.

🎯 Pixel-Perfect Shot Detection

Proprietary algorithms developed specifically for Laser Planet hardware ensure exceptional accuracy. The system automatically adapts to lighting and eliminates false detections.

📽️ Any Projector Compatible

Use any standard projector with your Laser Planet system. The software automatically calibrates to your projection surface dimensions and position.

⚙️ Quick Setup & Configuration

Built-in configurator optimized for Laser Planet hardware. Adjust camera settings, test detection, and complete calibration in under a minute.

📊 Comprehensive Score Tracking

Track your progress with detailed session statistics. Monitor improvement over time and compare scores with other shooters.

🔧 Intelligent Auto-Calibration

Advanced pattern recognition developed specifically for our hardware. Automatically maps shooting space and ignores ambient light sources like lamps or windows.

🎮 Multiple Training Modes

Various shooting scenarios and difficulty levels designed for professional training and entertainment.

🏆 Competition Ready

Save and compare scores. Perfect for tournaments, training assessments, and friendly competitions.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:

REQUIRED HARDWARE (sold separately by manufacturer):

• Laser Planet detection camera with optimized optics

• Laser Planet weapon replica with calibrated red laser

• Standard projector (any model)

• Projection surface (wall, screen, or shooting backdrop)

• USB 2.0 or higher port on PC

SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS:

• Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

• Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better

• 4 GB RAM minimum (8 GB recommended)

• DirectX 11 compatible graphics

• 1 GB available storage

COMPATIBILITY WARNING:

This software is designed EXCLUSIVELY for Laser Planet hardware. It will NOT work with generic USB webcams, consumer laser pointers, or other laser tag systems.

PERFECT FOR:

• Professional shooting training facilities

• Entertainment centers and arcades

• Schools and educational institutions

• Corporate team building events

• Home shooting ranges

• Shooting sport clubs and competitions

This software is part of the complete Laser Planet system. Hardware (camera and weapon replicas) must be purchased separately from the manufacturer.

Safe, realistic, and professionally designed - Laser Planet brings shooting range experience anywhere you have a wall and projector.
